about: Which scenarios in scenarios.json can be run as they stand. runnable: an empty workspace and the context as written are enough. repo-fixture: copy the listed paths from this repository into the workspace first. grader lists files under evals/graders/ that only the judge sees: run_scenarios.py copies them beside the workspace, never into it, and a test fails if a skill package ships one. Any scenario not listed is fixture-missing: its context describes a project or files that no fixture here supplies, so run_scenarios.py will not run it. partial names the nearest existing fixture and what it lacks.

system-design-adaptive-discovery.note: Interactive: the context's brief is stated as text; nobody answers questions in a headless run.

system-design-changed-collaboration-requ.note: Conversational only; the prior design is described in the context.

system-design-contracts-from-vague-requi.note: The context's mid-conversation addition about territory and flight dates cannot be delivered in one headless turn.

memory-retrieval-second-round.note: Measuring recall needs a shell, which the default agent tools leave out.
